capabilities.name: product-aggregate-read
capabilities.description: Read the m_collateral_management product row (id, name, quality, base_price, unit_type, pct_to_base, currency) by its primary key, as returned by the product read-back.
capabilities.evidence: Capture collateral-product-readback-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned the single product row (id 2, name SEED-Collateral-Product, quality Good, basePrice 100000.00000, unitType 1, pctToBase 50.00000, currency MNT).

capabilities.name: collateral-type-link
capabilities.description: Read the m_loan_collateral row (id, type_cv_id) by its primary key, as returned by the loan-collateral read-back.
capabilities.evidence: Capture loan-collateral-readback-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned the single link row (id 2, type.id 24), keyed by the LoanCollateral code value.

capabilities.name: client-collateral-read
capabilities.description: Read a client's collateral holdings page as returned by the client-collateral read-back.
capabilities.evidence: Capture client-collateral-readback-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned content [] for client 5 (an EMPTY page) even though its own write path stored holding id 2 under m_client_collateral_management (client-collateral-raw.json) — the read and write paths target different models in the pinned build.

capabilities.name: collateral-valuation
capabilities.description: Reproduce the SINGLE-row client-collateral read-back's computed valuation: total = base_price * quantity and total_collateral = total * pct_to_base/100, evaluated by the read path (the m_client_collateral_management column holds only quantity).
capabilities.evidence: Capture client-collateral-single-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned the single holding row (id 2, clientId 5, quantity 1.50000) WITH computed total 150000.0000000000 and totalCollateral 75000.000000000000000 (basePrice 100000.00000 * quantity 1.50000; total * pctToBase 50.00000/100), demonstrating the valuation arithmetic IS observable through an API read-back.

seams.name: collateral-product-read
seams.description: GET the collateral product read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the m_collateral_management aggregate row.

seams.name: collateral-link-read
seams.description: GET the loan-collateral read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the m_loan_collateral aggregate row.

seams.name: collateral-client-read
seams.description: GET the client-collateral read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the client's collateral holdings page (empty for client 5).

seams.name: collateral-valuation-read
seams.description: GET the single-row client-collateral read-back on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege (GET /clients/{clientId}/collaterals/{collateralId}): the holding with its COMPUTED valuation.

note: Collateral parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). Four capabilities are graded: the product aggregate read (collateral-product-read seam), the loan-collateral type_cv_id link read (collateral-link-read seam), the client-collateral read (collateral-client-read seam, graded on page presence: the oracle observed the EMPTY page for client 5) and the collateral valuation (collateral-valuation-read seam: the SINGLE-row read-back GET /clients/5/collaterals/2 returns computed total and totalCollateral on the read path, so the valuation arithmetic ClientCollateral.Total / TotalCollateral IS in the graded domain and a port whose arithmetic differs goes red on the transcribed capture).
